top_choice_rationale: P001, Mircea Cărtărescu alone, is the better-supported recommendation on the common criteria. From general public knowledge of Blinding (the Orbitor sequence) and Solenoid, his voice is distinctive. The long forms appear built, with recurring image systems, and memory, the body and dream are treated as one metaphysical project. Solenoid is widely seen as a late culmination, so I do not see a maturity problem. The citation should rest on the prose, with poetry named only as a root, because translated coverage of the poetry is thin. Unresolved reservations remain. I judge the Romanian prose only through translation. I cannot show whether the late novels deepen their image systems or recirculate them. The whole-oeuvre claim is partly inferred. I have not read the works or verified any sources. These are limits of access and not findings against the writer, so I rank P001 above no award (P000). The unanimous opening support is not evidence of merit and played no part in this ranking.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile. Documented connections are to colleagues and family, not to Cărtărescu: marriage to Pär Nuder, election alongside Steve Sem-Sandberg in 2020, and work with chair Anders Olsson. Her status as a co-opted member with an undocumented committee vote makes this simulated vote a modeling assumption. Disclosed, not adjudicated.
